source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Every model in a unit that attacks picks its weapons; ranged weapons make ranged attacks and melee weapons make melee attacks.

- Shooting: pick 1 or more of the model's ranged weapons, subject to restrictions such as **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)**.
- Fighting: pick exactly 1 of its melee weapons.

A model without a weapon of the needed type makes no attacks of that type. For a selected weapon with several profiles, choose 1 profile, used when its attacks are resolved; each model may choose differently. A Hunter profile can target only units with the keywords it names.

An attack has its weapon's characteristics and abilities. Modifiers and abilities that apply to an attack change the weapon until the attack sequence of the unit and every effect of those abilities are resolved, and roll modifiers on a weapon apply to its attacks. A unit **selected to shoot**, **selected to fight** or picked to make attacks counts as **selected to attack**.
